Class MethodInvokingRunnable

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.util.MethodInvoker
org.springframework.beans.support.ArgumentConvertingMethodInvoker
org.springframework.scheduling.support.MethodInvokingRunnable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, Aware, BeanClassLoaderAware, InitializingBean
public class MethodInvokingRunnable extends ArgumentConvertingMethodInvoker implements Runnable, BeanClassLoaderAware, InitializingBean
Adapter that implements the Runnable interface as a configurable method invocation based on Spring's MethodInvoker.

继承自 MethodInvoker 的通用配置属性。

Since:
1.2.4
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

    • setBeanClassLoader

      public void setBeanClassLoader(ClassLoader classLoader)
      描述从接口复制：BeanClassLoaderAware
      Callback that supplies the bean class loader to a bean instance.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充后之后但初始化回调（如 InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() 方法或自定义 init-method）之前之前调用。

      Specified by:
      `setBeanClassLoader` 接口 `BeanClassLoaderAware` 中
      Parameters:
      classLoader - 拥有者类加载器

    • resolveClassName

      protected Class<?> resolveClassName(String className) throws ClassNotFoundException
      描述从类复制：MethodInvoker
      Resolve the given class name into a Class.

      默认实现使用 `ClassUtils.forName`，并采用线程上下文类加载器。

      Overrides:
      `resolveClassName` 在类 `MethodInvoker` 中
      Parameters:
      className - 要解析的类名
      Returns:
      已解析的类
      Throws:
      ClassNotFoundException - 如果类名无效

    • afterPropertiesSet

      public void afterPropertiesSet() throws ClassNotFoundException, NoSuchMethodException
      描述从接口复制：InitializingBean
      Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.

      此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

      Specified by:
      `afterPropertiesSet` 接口中的 `InitializingBean`
      Throws:
      ClassNotFoundException
      NoSuchMethodException
